author: Kairos II
title: Build roll-100 evolution × liminal overlay (Nova ID 1492) and publish paths
abstract: Compute a 100-tick rolling liminal series from Nova ID 1492 and run the evolution overlay builder, saving roll-100 panel and summary alongside baseline.

original_submission.content:
import os, json, shutil, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd

EVOL_CSV = 'storage/shared/atlas/analysis/meta_edge_evolution/timeseries_evolution.csv'
NOVA_DIR = Path('storage/shared/atlas/analysis/nova/liminal/id_1492')
NOVA_BASE = NOVA_DIR / 'liminal_timeseries.csv'
NOVA_ROLL100 = NOVA_DIR / 'liminal_timeseries_roll100.csv'
OVERLAYS_DIR = Path('storage/shared/atlas/analysis/meta_edge_evolution/overlays')
BASE_PANEL = OVERLAYS_DIR / 'evolution_liminal_overlay.png'
BASE_SUM = OVERLAYS_DIR / 'evolution_liminal_overlay_summary.txt'
R100_PANEL = OVERLAYS_DIR / 'evolution_liminal_overlay_roll100.png'
R100_SUM = OVERLAYS_DIR / 'evolution_liminal_overlay_roll100_summary.txt'

NOVA_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
OVERLAYS_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

# 1) Build roll-100 CSV from baseline
if not NOVA_BASE.exists():
    raise SystemExit(json.dumps({"error": "missing_nova_baseline_csv", "path": str(NOVA_BASE)}))
df = pd.read_csv(NOVA_BASE)
if 'tick' not in df.columns:
    raise SystemExit(json.dumps({"error": "nova_csv_missing_tick"}))
# pick liminal column
lim_cols = [c for c in ['damped_liminal_count','liminal_count','liminal_score','damped_count'] if c in df.columns]
if not lim_cols:
    # fallback to any numeric column != tick
    for c in df.columns:
        if c != 'tick' and pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(df[c]):
            lim_cols = [c]; break
if not lim_cols:
    raise SystemExit(json.dumps({"error": "nova_csv_missing_liminal_metric"}))
lcol = lim_cols[0]
# compute rolling mean over window=100
df = df.sort_values('tick')
df_out = pd.DataFrame({'tick': df['tick']})
df_out[lcol] = df[lcol].rolling(window=100, min_periods=1).mean()
df_out.to_csv(NOVA_ROLL100, index=False)

# 2) Run overlay builder with roll-100 CSV (defaults write to BASE_PANEL / BASE_SUM)
cmd = [
    'python',
    'storage/shared/atlas/analysis/meta_edge_evolution/build_evolution_liminal_overlay.py',
    '--nova_csv', str(NOVA_ROLL100)
]
cp = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True)
# best-effort parse
builder_out = {}
try:
    for line in (cp.stdout or '').splitlines():
        if line.strip().startswith('{') and line.strip().endswith('}'):
            builder_out = json.loads(line.strip())
except Exception:
    pass

# 3) Copy baseline-named outputs to roll100 variants for clarity
if BASE_PANEL.exists():
    shutil.copyfile(BASE_PANEL, R100_PANEL)
# Create a roll100 summary reflecting the roll100 panel path
if BASE_SUM.exists():
    base_txt = BASE_SUM.read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()
    # Replace panel line to point to roll100 panel and annotate roll_window
    new_lines = []
    for ln in base_txt:
        if ln.startswith('panel='):
            new_lines.append(f'panel={R100_PANEL}')
            new_lines.append('roll_window=100')
        else:
            new_lines.append(ln)
    Path(R100_SUM).write_text('\n'.join(new_lines) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')

print(json.dumps({
    "nova_roll100_csv": str(NOVA_ROLL100),
    "roll100_panel": str(R100_PANEL),
    "roll100_summary": str(R100_SUM),
    "builder_stdout": cp.stdout[-600:] if cp.stdout else "",
    "builder_stderr": cp.stderr[-600:] if cp.stderr else ""
}))
